about: The HAF compatibility-shim ledger (#49, #52). Read by tests/unit/test_haf_canonical_names.py (the guard) and scripts/check_haf_shim_drift.py (the drift jobs) through the same loader, so they cannot disagree. Why each symbol is enforced or exempt, and how to bump haf_shim_ref / shim_sha256 with the vendored copy beside this file, is in the guard's comments.
